title: Restrictions of an invertible module along two rational points of an open of affine space are isomorphic
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a normal variety X over k and an open subscheme U of affine n-space containing k-rational points p and q, the restrictions of any invertible module on X times U to the fibres over p and q are isomorphic. The proof observes that the fibres of the projection are open subschemes of affine n-space over fields, hence have trivial Picard groups, and then applies the criterion for describing invertible modules as pullbacks along a morphism whose fibres have trivial Picard groups (proof lines 5877-5883). H2: identifying the fibres and applying the pullback criterion in the right direction is the substance, and both steps are specific geometric inputs rather than bookkeeping.
